Thanks again for agreeing to co-sell a joint demo with OrbitLine and Redwood. - US (PST): Tue 2026-11-23 10:00–11:00 PT / suitable for US sales teams and AWS West contacts
- EU (CET): Wed 2026-11-24 15:00–16:00 CET / for EMEA field teams
- APAC (SGT/AWST window): Thu 2026-11-25 17:30–18:30 SGT (works as evening for SE/SG) OR Fri 2026-11-26 09:00–10:00 AWST

Notes / asks:
- Preferred primary cloud for the demo: AWS (default), Azure, or GCP? We should align the live demo node and URLs.
- SI presenter: please confirm who from OrbitLine will lead the integration deep-dive (30m).
- Recording/Listing: we plan to capture the session for the Marketplace listing; let us know if any content must be redacted.

I've attached a draft runbook and a short agenda to start. If you can mark availability on the matrix by EOD Monday (2026-11-15), we'll lock an initial slot and send invites.

Attachments: runbook-draft.pdf, co-sell-agenda.md

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
